name: Test Suites MCP
description: MCP server that exposes the Darwin test suites as tools: run_integration_suite (IntegrationRun) and run_retrieval_suite (RetrievalRun).

parameters.instructions: Test suite runners for the Darwin agent. run_integration_suite checks tool routing and tool results through the agent (integration_cases). run_retrieval_suite scores retrieval quality through the agent (retrieval_cases). Both run synchronously, write results to the shared testing Supabase project, and post reports to Slack. Prefer one run at a time.

parameters.description: Runs the Darwin integration test suite (IntegrationRun). Executes every enabled case in integration_cases through the agent, evaluates assertions, writes integration_results, and posts a summary to Slack (#C09DRCJLQCE). Runs synchronously — a full run takes 2-5 minutes. Returns the Slack post result. Input: requested_by (who or what asked for the run).

parameters.description: Runs the Darwin retrieval eval suite (RetrievalRun). Executes retrieval_cases through the agent, scores them, writes retrieval_results, and posts a report to Slack (#C09DRCJLQCE). Runs synchronously — a full run takes 5-10 minutes. Inputs (all optional): requested_by; category (multi-turn | source-specific | broad | time-bound | structure); slug (one case); transport (direct | slack, default direct); channel_id (Slack channel for slack-transport threads, default C0BQH5S6P1P); bot_id (Darwin bot user, env-aware default).
